description: Get from A to B with EDK-1 around what you name, like potholed streets, construction or crash-prone intersections, and past what you want to see. from and to take a place name, an address, or "lat, lng". Returns distance, duration, the path as GeoJSON, turn-by-turn steps, what was avoided, and the direct route for comparison.

conditions.description: What to stay clear of, in plain words. Optional.

from.description: Start: a place name, an address, or "lat, lng".

include.description: What to pass on the way, in plain words, like "a coffee shop" or "scenic overlooks". Optional.

profile.description: Default driving. Conditions steer driving routes only.

to.description: End: a place name, an address, or "lat, lng".

name: edk_route
